FLA.head: Florida should have the upper hand
FLA.body: Florida has controlled the play far better over recent games and has home ice. Vancouver’s way back in is keeping the shots to the outside.

VAN.head: A tough matchup for Vancouver
VAN.body: Florida has controlled the play far better over recent games and has home ice. Vancouver can pull it off if it keeps the shots to the outside.
